caption: **Sauna and mortality.** One large Finnish study found men who used a sauna 4–7 times a week had a 40% lower risk of death from any cause than those using it once a week. But this is an observational study — it can't prove **sauna use itself causes the benefit**, since other lifestyle factors may explain it. It also involved only middle-aged Finnish men and measured habits just once, so the evidence isn't conclusive.
subtitle: One observational study in Finnish men can't prove cause and effect.
